mapper.select: SELECT r.run_id AS runId, r.budget_amount AS budgetAmount, SUM(CASE WHEN b.state = 'RESERVED' THEN b.amount ELSE 0 END) AS reservedAmount, SUM(CASE WHEN b.state = 'SETTLED' THEN b.amount ELSE 0 END) AS settledAmount FROM run r LEFT JOIN budget_reservation b ON b.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND b.run_id = r.run_id WHERE r.tenant_id = #{tenantId}::uuid AND r.run_id = #{runId}::uuid GROUP BY r.run_id, r.budget_amount
